resources.string: Your phone gets a lot of notifications. NotiRegX lets you decide which ones deserve your attention, using rules that match the app, the title or the text.
Likes, promos and reactions disappear, but stay saved in the Archive in case you want them.
Collect less urgent things into one notification with a count, or a digest at set times.
Let important people and urgent words through, even in Do Not Disturb.
See every vibration, including \"ghost\" buzzes with no notification behind them.
A rule matches notifications by app and by a pattern in the title or text. Rules run from top to bottom, and the last rule that matches decides what happens.
Rule 1: Hide everything from Instagram. Rule 2 (below it): Always alert when the text mentions your name. Mentions get through and ring; everything else from Instagram is hidden.
Android needs your permission before an app can read and filter notifications. Everything stays on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere.
Required. Turn NotiRegX on in the list that opens.
Samsung: if Android says notification access is a \"restricted setting\", open App info, tap ⋮ and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
None of these are needed to start. You can turn them on later in Settings.
Recommended on Samsung, so the phone doesn\'t put the filter to sleep.
Lets \"Always alert\" rules ring through Do Not Disturb.
Stops filtered notifications from buzzing at all. Pick any nearby Bluetooth device; nothing is sent to it.
To see vibrations that come with no notification, run this once from a computer with adb: %1$s
Let NotiRegX run for a while, then turn what you see into rules.
Archive › Recent: tap Make rule on anything annoying. NotiRegX suggests patterns based on similar notifications.
Swipe away what you don\'t want as usual. After a few, \"Suggested for you\" proposes rules on the Rules tab.
Archive › Senders ranks people and apps by how much they send you.
The Vibrations tab lists every buzz. Add the \"Last buzz\" quick-settings tile to check in one tap.
